top_signals.title: Qatari PM heads to Iran to 'de-escalate tensions' as tanker attack tests Trump’s Hormuz claim
top_signals.summary: The Prime Minister of U.S.-ally Qatar is in Iran for talks on Thursday as part of efforts to "de-escalate tensions" between Tehran and Washington.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Heavy rain ongoing in Toyama and Ishikawa prefectures as warnings downgraded
top_signals.summary: The weather agency had urged residents in Toyama and Ishikawa prefectures to evacuate earlier Thursday in order to ensure their safety.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
